title: Indo-European languages - Wikipedia
text: Today the individual Indo-European languages with the most native speakers are English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Hindustani (Urdu and Hindi), Bengali, Punjabi, French, German and Persian; many others spoken by smaller groups are in danger of extinction.

title: Music of India - Wikipedia
text: Owing to India's vastness and diversity, Indian music encompasses numerous genres in multiple varieties and forms which include classical music, folk, rock, and pop. It has a history spanning several millennia and developed over several geo-locations spanning the sub-continent. Music in India began as an integral part of socio-religious life.
